primary_analysis_rule: ALL-TASKS / FAIL-CLOSED. No silent exclusions. Strategy-level completion without selected paths -> EMPTY prediction. Unrecoverable execution or transport failure -> EMPTY prediction in the primary analysis with a separate failure flag. Sensitivity analysis may exclude ONLY pre-defined infrastructure failures and must be reported alongside the primary, never instead of it.
interpretation_rule: If RM-CSS appears better mainly because the repository-agent instrument produces many empty/failed outputs, report that as an instrument/operational finding, not pure method superiority.

retry.transport: max 3 byte-identical retries; ONLY transport failures may be retried

malformed: invalid JSON -> error appended; continue if calls remain; else EMPTY
invalid_paths: outside editable universe -> error; continue if calls remain; else EMPTY
round_cap_reached: remaining agent calls exhausted without final -> EMPTY prediction
partial_tool_failure: tool error result returned to the agent; loop continues; repeated identical tool request rejected
